findings.failure_mode: The ring metric is blind to a wedge missing from ONE leg: bearings where either profile is null are dropped and ringVerdict has no coverage clause, so a 60° missing wedge (~0.83 area, inside ±21%) passes (sol#1, opus#1; 3× recurring).
Fail-OPEN NaN in the ORS provenance cross-check: ratio = areaD/areaP with a zero/NaN app-ring area makes Math.abs(NaN-1) > 0.02 false, so the preflight silently passes (sonnet#2).
The manifest calls the non-unity area ratios 'the operative proof' of distinct backends — unsound (toFixed(3) hides a true 1.000; a same-host older-vintage cache row is also non-unity) (opus#3).
findings.fix_evidence: the **primary proof is the mechanized preflight**

findings.failure_mode: Tile HTTP-cache footgun: /api/tiles sends max-age=86400, so repointing one origin to a different archive serves stale byte ranges (blank map) until a hard reload (opus#4).
'~8 GB resident' understates the footprint: the ~2.25 GB Protomaps base-source cache is a separate build artifact (sol#4).
findings.fix_evidence: is a **separate build cache**, not serving data
